name: Tirilazad
summary: Tirilazad is a drug that has been proposed to treat acute ischaemic stroke. When tested on animal models, tirilazad protects brain tissue, and reduces brain damage. However, the drug failed to demonstrate efficacy in humans and may even worsen stroke-related outcomes.

uses.text: Tirilazad is a drug that has been proposed to treat acute ischaemic stroke. More recently, tirilazad has shown some promising results in treating traumatic brain injury (TBI).
